scripts.text: - You have too many items. Please make space. -
scripts.translation: - 物品太多了，請騰出空間。-

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Look... the Magic Academy
in Geffen is now directly
selling the brand new
^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
看...吉芬魔法學院現在直接出售全新的^007777露天商店檢索卡(銀)^000000！

scripts.text:
He is looking at the words
written on his hand.
He seems too busy
to look at you.
scripts.translation:
他正低頭看著寫在手上的字。
他好像太忙了，顧不上看你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
A brand new catalog
has just come out!
You can check
what items you can trade
and what items are on sale
from the vendor.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
新款目錄剛剛推出！
用它就能查詢商人正在出售哪些物品。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The ^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000
costs only 200z!
You can buy up to 50 pieces at once!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
^007777露天商店檢索卡(銀)^000000只要200 Zeny！
一次最多可以買50張！

scripts.text: You don't look like a vendor!

[Catalog Magician]
You... want all 50 pieces?
Or how many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
你...要買整整50張？
還是說，你想買多少張？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The trade has been stopped!
I don't know what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
交易被中斷了！
我不知道接下來該怎麼辦...
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
It should be less than 50 pieces.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
購買數量要少於50張。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
It seems you don't have enough money.
You can sell your equipment
to make more money... if you want.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
你要買{0}張目錄，共計{1} Zeny。
看來你的錢不夠。
要不賣掉一些裝備湊錢...當然，隨你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
Ok, here you go.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
你要買{0}張目錄，共計{1} Zeny。
好的，給你。

Ok, here you go.
scripts.translation:
你要買{0}張目錄，共計{1} Zeny。
好的，給你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Argh... you really need this
item... Do you want me to
explain again? I don't know
what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
啊...你真的很需要這個東西...要我再解釋一遍嗎？
我不知道接下來該怎麼辦...
該怎麼辦才好？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
My real job is a magician.
I was going to ask the merchant
guild to sell them, but they were
trying use them as an appendix
into broom sales. That's why
I'm selling these by myself.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
其實我是個魔法師。
我本來想請商人公會代售這些目錄，可他們居然想把目錄當作賣掃帚的贈品。
所以我只好自己來賣了。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
There are many adventurers
here who come and go.
I'm pretty sure that I can sell to all of them soon.
Don't you think so?
So... let's start!! Buy more of them, please! PLEASE...!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
這裡來往的冒險者這麼多，肯定很快就能賣光。
你說是吧？
那麼...快來買吧！！多買一點！拜託了...！
